name: gravity2d
description: Gravity: entities that have a Gravity are pulled in a direction, so that their Velocity grows each tick. Jumps, falls, thrown objects and arrows all come from it. The y axis points down, as on screen, so a gravity of 900 pulls downwards.

components.name: Gravity
components.description: Adds x and y (world units per second, per second) to the entity's Velocity every tick. terminal_speed, when it is not 0, is the fastest the entity may fall along each axis that gravity pulls on, in units per second: a falling body stops speeding up there (the speed in the other direction, a jump upwards, is not limited).

systems.name: pull
systems.description: Speeds up the Velocity of every Gravity entity by its gravity times the tick duration (and the transform2d speed_scale, and the entity's own transform2d.SpeedScale), then applies the terminal speed. Runs before transform2d.integrate, so a body that was thrown moves the very tick it is thrown.
